response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical depth, extensive experience in developer tools (test runners, CI/CD, DLang libraries), and clear leadership through workshops and open-source projects, but lacks explicit evidence of people management, organizational change leadership, or mobile platform expertise — key requirements for this role.
strengths: Extensive hands-on experience building developer tools (test runners, CI systems, code generators)
Proven track record of technical leadership via workshops, open-source projects, and team mentoring
Broad technical stack across mobile, web, and infrastructure (including iOS app development and Docker/K8s)
concerns: No clear evidence of formal people management or team leadership beyond technical mentorship
Limited demonstrable experience in mobile platform ecosystems (iOS/Android) as a manager
Absence of documented experience leading organizational change or strategic roadmap ownership
